interface_proposal.status: Frozen source requirements only; kernel ownership and actual native acceptance pending parent assignment.
interface_proposal.rankview_abi: Unchanged. Reuse existing image/footprint/mask view; separate vector-output descriptor/API instead of adding image channels to RankView.
interface_proposal.vector_output: 2D image; positive output depth and spatial extents at least input extent in qualified calls, fused u8/u16/f32/f64, defaultf64. Source preserves supplied3D output shape/identity; supplied2D can reshape only where depth1 is compatible.
interface_proposal.capacity_vs_channels: histogram_capacity=256 for prepared uint8; max(3,max(prepared_uint16))+1 for uint16. output_depth defaults to int(raw_image.max())+1 before preprocessing, or supplied out.shape[2]. Public n_bins sets only newly allocated/2D-reshaped pixel size; it is ignored by supplied3D out. Never use output depth as histogram capacity.
interface_proposal.noise_stages: Sequence rejection and copied-footprint center clearing precede common dtype/shape validation.2D wrapper/core centers both use[y,x];3D wrapper clear uses[y,x,z], while core centers use[x,y,z]. Caller footprint is unchanged.
interface_proposal.normalization_order: Histogram count * reciprocal(pop), not per-bin count/pop; scalar subtract_mean also retains stated floating operation order; geometric_mean retains ascending-bin C-libm replay and round helper.
